retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast dual portrait featuring a vertical marquee-style title separating two faces with distinct light and dark backgrounds.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical composition featuring two female faces in close-up, divided by a central vertical column of marquee-bulb lettering. The left side is dominated by deep black shadows and dark hair, while the right side transitions into a high-key white background with blonde hair. Vibrant magenta is used exclusively for the lips and the glow of the marquee letters.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical marquee text acting as a central axis and divider
Chiaroscuro contrast between the left (dark) and right (light) halves
Color harmony between magenta lips and magenta-tinted light bulbs
Symmetrical eye-level placement of the two subjects
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of the primary title
High-contrast skin tones against monochromatic backgrounds
Magenta as the sole chromatic accent color

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale faces flanking the center, cropped at the forehead and neck.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical marquee title in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central glowing text outward to the subjects' eyes, then down to the matching magenta lips.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black on the left and stark white on the right create a balanced void.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast (0% to 100% brightness) with high-saturation magenta accents.

letterConstructionRules: Internal fill composed of circular light bulb patterns
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are treated as physical 3D marquee signs with depth
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy decorative vertical title paired with a wide-tracked, clean sans-serif header.

candidateDirections.reason: Strong vertical presence and blocky structure for the base skeleton.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dual portrait of two women's faces. The left side should have a black background and dark hair; the right side should have a white background and blonde hair. Both should have vibrant magenta lipstick. Leave a clear vertical channel in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical stack of bold, uppercase letters in the center channel. Apply a marquee light bulb texture inside the letters and a magenta outer glow.

verificationChecks: Are the lips and text the same shade of magenta?
Is there a clear black-to-white background split?
Do the letters contain visible light bulb patterns?
